text:
The difference is I'm independent, so I've got access to 40+ lenders instead of just the one product a bank's going to push at you. That means I'm actually working for you, not for a bank's own book.

Then I run the whole thing end to end, first call right through to settlement, so you're not stuck chasing paperwork or figuring it out yourself.

And it doesn't stop at settlement either, I keep an eye on your rate and I'm there for whatever's next, refinancing, next property, whatever it is. A bank can't do any of that for you, they can only sell you what they've got.
